battleFormations.name: Liberator Assault Group
battleFormations.effect: Red Thirst: Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight, if that unit made a Charge move this turn, until end of phase add 1 to the Attacks and add 2 to the Strength characteristic of melee weapons equipped by models in that unit. Restriction: army can include BLOOD ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

battleFormations.name: The Lost Brethren
battleFormations.effect: A Noble Death in Combat: Each time a DEATH COMPANY model makes a melee attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1 if that model's unit is below Starting Strength (re-roll the Wound roll instead if Below Half-strength). DEATH COMPANY MARINES and DEATH COMPANY MARINES WITH BOLT RIFLES units gain the BATTLELINE keyword. Restriction: army can include BLOOD ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

battleFormations.name: The Angelic Host
battleFormations.effect: Upon Wings of Fire: At the end of your opponent's turn, select up to 1/2/3 (Incursion/Strike Force/Onslaught) ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK units not within Engagement Range of enemies; remove them to Strategic Reserves and set them up again via Deep Strike in your next Movement phase. Restriction: army can include BLOOD ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

battleFormations.name: Angelic Inheritors
battleFormations.effect: Legacy of the Angel: At the start of the first battle round, select two Angelic Legacy abilities (Sanguinary Grace: eligible to shoot/charge after Falling Back; Carmine Wrath: re-roll Hit/Wound rolls of 1; Their Appointed Hour: re-roll Advance/Charge rolls) to apply to all ADEPTUS ASTARTES CHARACTER units for the rest of the battle. Restriction: army can include BLOOD ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

battleFormations.name: Rage-cursed Onslaught
battleFormations.effect: Maddened Ferocity: Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES model makes a melee attack, re-roll a Wound roll of 1. Each time an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit is selected to fight, if it made a Charge move this turn, add 1 to the Attacks characteristic of melee weapons (add 2 instead if the unit is Battle-shocked) until end of phase. Restriction: army can include BLOOD ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

battleFormations.name: Legacy of Grace
battleFormations.effect: Legacy of the Angel: Friendly BLOOD ANGELS INFANTRY CHARACTER units (excluding COMMANDER DANTE) have +1 to Advance rolls and Charge rolls. Has the GRACE tag; cannot be taken with another GRACE detachment. Restriction: army can include BLOOD ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

battleFormations.name: Encarmine Speartip
battleFormations.effect: Wrath of Angels: When a friendly SANGUINARY GUARD unit is selected to make a Fall Back move, that move does not prevent it from being eligible to shoot or declare a charge. Restriction: army can include BLOOD ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

battleFormations.name: Wrath of the Doomed
battleFormations.effect: Fanatical Celerity: When a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is selected to Advance, you can choose for it to suffer D3+1 mortal wounds; if so, that move does not prevent it from being eligible to declare a charge. Has the DOOMED tag; cannot be taken with another DOOMED detachment. Restriction: army can include BLOOD ANGELS units only, no other Chapter's ADEPTUS ASTARTES units.

artefacts.name: Speed of the Primarch
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability until end of phase.

artefacts.name: Rage-fuelled Warrior
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, the bearer's melee weapons have the [SUSTAINED HITS 3] ability until end of phase.

artefacts.name: Icon of the Angel
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Enemy units (excluding MONSTERS/VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer's unit that Fall Back must take Desperate Escape tests as if Battle-shocked (with -1 if already Battle-shocked).

artefacts.name: Gift of Foresight
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Once per battle round, treat a Hit roll, Wound roll or saving throw for the bearer as an unmodified 6.

artefacts.name: Sanguinius' Grace
artefacts.effect: [DEATH COMPANY model only] Once per battle, at the end of the Fight phase, if within Engagement Range of three or more enemy models, the bearer can fight one additional time.

artefacts.name: Blood Shard
artefacts.effect: [DEATH COMPANY model only] The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at end of phase: on a 2+, set it back up unengaged as close as possible with 3 wounds remaining.

artefacts.name: To Slay the Warmaster
artefacts.effect: [DEATH COMPANY model only] Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, if within Engagement Range of an enemy CHARACTER unit, roll six D6: each 4+ inflicts 1 mortal wound on a model in that unit.

artefacts.name: Vengeful Onslaught
artefacts.effect: [DEATH COMPANY model only] If the bearer is destroyed, until end of your next turn, add 1 to the Hit roll for attacks made by friendly DEATH COMPANY models.

artefacts.name: Artisan of War
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only] Improve the Armour Penetration characteristic of the bearer's weapons by 1; the bearer has a Save characteristic of 2+.

artefacts.name: Visage of Death
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only] In the Battle-shock step of your opponent's Command phase, each enemy unit (excluding MONSTERS/VEHICLES) within Engagement Range of the bearer must take a Battle-shock test.

artefacts.name: Archangel's Shard
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only] The bearer's melee weapons have the [ANTI-CHAOS 5+] and [LANCE] abilities.

artefacts.name: Gleaming Pinions
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only] In your opponent's Movement phase, if an enemy unit ends a move within 8" and the bearer's unit isn't within Engagement Range of an enemy, it can make a Normal move of up to 6".

artefacts.name: Prescient Flash
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability.

artefacts.name: Troubling Visions
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Once per battle, in your Command phase, all Angelic Legacy abilities become active for the bearer's unit (instead of only two) until your next Command phase.

artefacts.name: Blazing Icon
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES INFANTRY model only] Enemy units cannot use the Fire Overwatch Stratagem to shoot at the bearer's unit.

artefacts.name: Ordained Sacrifice
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] The first time the bearer is destroyed, roll one D6 at end of phase: on a 2+, set it back up unengaged as close as possible with 3 wounds remaining.

artefacts.name: Carmine Reliquary
artefacts.effect: [CHAPLAIN model only] Models in the bearer's unit have the Scouts 6" ability. You can re-roll Battle-shock tests for ADEPTUS ASTARTES units within 6" of the bearer.

artefacts.name: Master of the Red Thirst
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Once per battle, at the start of the Fight phase, models in the bearer's unit have the Fights First ability until end of phase.

artefacts.name: Sanguinary Tear
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only, Aura] While a friendly DEATH COMPANY unit is within 6" of the bearer, add 1 to the Strength characteristic of weapons equipped by models in that unit.

artefacts.name: Angel's Fang
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] Each time the bearer makes a melee attack that targets a CHARACTER, MONSTER or VEHICLE unit, that attack has the [SUSTAINED HITS 2] ability.

artefacts.name: Blood Boil
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES PSYKER model only] This model's [PSYCHIC] attacks have [ANTI: non-MONSTER/VEHICLE 5+] and can re-roll Damage rolls.

artefacts.name: Aureole of the Angel
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES model only] This unit has -3" detection range.

artefacts.name: Angelic Executioner
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only] When selected to fight, this unit's melee attacks have [LETHAL HITS] or [SUSTAINED HITS 1] (your choice).

artefacts.name: Shadow of Abomination
artefacts.effect: [ADEPTUS ASTARTES JUMP PACK model only] Once per battle, when selected to fight, this model's melee attacks have +1 Damage.

artefacts.name: Instinctive Interception
artefacts.effect: [DEATH COMPANY model only] When you target this unit with the Heroic Intervention Stratagem, that use costs 1 fewer CP.

artefacts.name: On the Archtraitor's Bridge
artefacts.effect: [DEATH COMPANY model only] This model's melee attacks have +2 Attacks.

armyRules.name: The Sons of Sanguinius
armyRules.effect: If an ADEPTUS ASTARTES unit has a second Faction keyword on its datasheet, that is the unit's Chapter (e.g. Lemartes is BLOOD ANGELS). You cannot include units from more than one Chapter in your army.

sourceNotes: Extracted from Wahapedia wh40k11ed Space Marines page, Blood Angels Codex Supplement section (Chapter filter: Blood Angels). Covers all 8 Blood Angels Detachments, the Army Rule (The Sons of Sanguinius), and Enhancements. Stratagems and base Codex: Space Marines Detachments not included (see Space Marines.rules.json for shared ADEPTUS ASTARTES detachments/Oath of Moment).
